reference_file: /home/luolie/biopipeline/dimension-reduction/plantnet/缝合模块/即插即用/223 Parameter-Free Edge-Structure Attention(MICCAI 2026).py
reference_title: PFESA: FFT-based Parameter-Free Edge and Structure Attention for Medical Image Segmentation
core_mechanism: parameter-free reliability score from log-expression graph low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual
neighbor_mix_relation: independent; NeighborMix is not used and no cell mixing is performed
implementation_notes: scaled_expr is used only as encoder input
log_expr is used for reconstruction target and graph reliability construction
the image FFT operation is replaced by KNN graph structure/residual decomposition
large datasets use an anchor-KNN fallback to avoid full pairwise KNN memory/thread failures
screen results are written only to quick-screen CSV files
